request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material, skin and fabric texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Nobody looks at the camera. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Image 1 shows a customer and a seller at a covered market stall. Keep both people exactly: the customer is a woman of about thirty with long wavy black hair, a mustard-yellow cardigan over a white top and a brown shoulder bag; the seller is a man of about thirty with short dark hair, a dark-grey T-shirt and a green apron, behind the same rustic wooden counter in the same market. Create a NEW photograph at this stall: the customer FINDS her money in her bag. She stands at the counter, holds her brown shoulder bag open with one hand and with the other hand lifts a few folded green banknotes out of it, half of them still inside the bag; she looks down at the money with a relieved smile, as someone who has just found it. The seller waits behind the counter with empty hands. The counter is empty: no price card, no bread and no milk. The open bag, her hands and the banknotes are sharp and clearly visible. Exactly two people. No readable letters, words or numbers anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.
